caption: The pipeline turns a two-qubit circuit into measured bitstrings. Notice that the final counts cluster near 512 for 00 and 512 for 11 when the simulator is ideal.

spec.title: Qiskit workflow
spec.aria: A left-to-right pipeline from creating a two-qubit circuit, adding H and CNOT, measuring both qubits, running 1024 shots on a simulator, to counts near 512 for 00 and 512 for 11.
